S.FORM: miana 'una kaan tacin manu ah Pori kaan ah nganaiin.
S.PHON: miana ʔuna kaan taʦin manu ah po[r|ɾ]i kaan ah ŋanaiin
S.FORM: miana 'una kaan tacin manu ah Pori kaan ah nganaiin.
S.PHON: miana ʔuna kaan taʦin manu ah po[r|ɾ]i kaan ah ŋanaiin
S.TRANSL: 從前,有一個小孩,名字是Pori.
In the past, there was a kid named Pori.

FORM.notes: source note: cʉvʉrʉ生長。 | source note: 「使生長」亦即「飼養」。 | source note: tamtitu特指幼狗; tacau 狗的總稱。

S.FORM: uh 'una nipapacʉvʉrʉkee takarura mataa 'una tamtitu.
S.PHON: uh ʔuna nipapaʦɨvɨ[r|ɾ]ɨkee taka[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ]a mataa ʔuna tamtitu
S.FORM: uh 'una nipapacʉvʉrʉkee takarura mataa 'una tamtitu.
S.PHON: uh ʔuna nipapaʦɨvɨ[r|ɾ]ɨkee taka[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ]a mataa ʔuna tamtitu
S.TRANSL: 養了青蛙和小狗.
(he) kept a frog and a puppy.

W.TRANSL: 過去-重疊-使役-生長=3SG.屬格

S.FORM: eh cʉ'ʉrʉʉnkee sua uh nipapacʉvʉrʉkee sua takarura.
S.PHON: eh ʦɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]ɨɨnkee sua uh nipapaʦɨvɨ[r|ɾ]ɨkee sua taka[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ]a
S.FORM: eh cʉ'ʉrʉʉnkee sua uh nipapacʉvʉrʉkee sua takarura.
S.PHON: eh ʦɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]ɨɨnkee sua uh nipapaʦɨvɨ[r|ɾ]ɨkee sua taka[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ]a
S.TRANSL: 看到所飼養的青蛙.
(He) saw the frog he kept.

W.TRANSL: 過去-重複-使役-生長=3SG.屬格

FORM.notes: source note: umoni 鳥禽類在叫。

S.FORM: 'esi nia kangvang sua ta ʉncoo tamtitu 'esi porun.
S.PHON: ʔesi nia kaŋvaŋ sua ta ɨnʦoo tamtitu ʔesi po[r|ɾ]un
S.FORM: 'esi nia kangvang sua ta ʉncoo tamtitu 'esi porun.
S.PHON: ʔesi nia kaŋvaŋ sua ta ɨnʦoo tamtitu ʔesi po[r|ɾ]un
S.TRANSL: 小狗都在那邊一直叫.
The puppy was barking there.

FORM.notes: source note: n這裡常有同化作用，會發成masarumpʉ。

S.FORM: ʉ makasuacu ʉ ʉ 'esicu masarunpʉ sin'icʉpʉ na tatarʉ sua ʉ mamanu.
S.PHON: ɨ makasuaʦu ɨ ɨ ʔesiʦu masa[r|ɾ]unpɨ sinʔiʦɨpɨ na tata[r|ɾ]ɨ sua ɨ mamanu
S.FORM: ʉ makasuacu ʉ ʉ 'esicu masarunpʉ sin'icʉpʉ na tatarʉ sua ʉ mamanu.
S.PHON: ɨ makasuaʦu ɨ ɨ ʔesiʦu masa[r|ɾ]unpɨ sinʔiʦɨpɨ na tata[r|ɾ]ɨ sua ɨ mamanu
S.TRANSL: 之後,小孩覺得睏了,在床上睡覺.
Afterwards, the kids had felt sleepy and slept in the bed.

S.FORM: sua Pori kisʉʉn mataa nguain tamna tamtitu arakukun si'icʉpʉ.
S.PHON: sua po[r|ɾ]i kisɨɨn mataa ŋuain tamna tamtitu a[r|ɾ]akukun siʔiʦɨpɨ
S.FORM: sua Pori kisʉʉn mataa nguain tamna tamtitu arakukun si'icʉpʉ.
S.PHON: sua po[r|ɾ]i kisɨɨn mataa ŋuain tamna tamtitu a[r|ɾ]akukun siʔiʦɨpɨ
S.TRANSL: Pori和她的小狗一起睡覺.
Pori and his puppy slept together.

FORM.notes: source note: mesua稍早的發音是miasua。 | source note: vankavuku 長褲。 | source note: saputu 裙子。 | source note: nakʉvʉ 指某物品，可能用布或麻所製成。 | source note: nonoman 指除了吃的東西除外的所有物品。 | source note: 此句尚未完整。

S.FORM: ʉ mesua ia sua kavangvang nguain tamna tikuru mataa nguain tamna carapung sua nipapacʉvʉrʉkee.
S.PHON: ɨ mesua ia sua kavaŋvaŋ ŋuain tamna tiku[r|ɾ]u mataa ŋuain tamna ʦa[r|ɾ]apuŋ sua nipapaʦɨvɨ[r|ɾ]ɨkee
S.FORM: ʉ mesua ia sua kavangvang nguain tamna tikuru mataa nguain tamna carapung sua nipapacʉvʉrʉkee.
S.PHON: ɨ mesua ia sua kavaŋvaŋ ŋuain tamna tiku[r|ɾ]u mataa ŋuain tamna ʦa[r|ɾ]apuŋ sua nipapaʦɨvɨ[r|ɾ]ɨkee
S.TRANSL: 當時,他的所有衣服、帽子和所養的
Then, all his clothes, hat, and what he fed…

W.TRANSL: 完成-重疊-使役-生長=3SG.屬格

FORM.notes: source note: tisikara指在洞或是容器裡面。 | source note: pipiningi 室外、外面、廣場。 | source note: aravang 有屋子的室內。 | source note: 特指竹製的容器。

S.FORM: sua ʉncoo takaruru ia 'esi tisikara na ʉ pupunga pania.
S.PHON: sua ɨnʦoo taka[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ]u ia ʔesi tisika[r|ɾ]a na ɨ pupuŋa pania
S.FORM: sua ʉncoo takaruru ia 'esi tisikara na ʉ pupunga pania.
S.PHON: sua ɨnʦoo taka[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ]u ia ʔesi tisika[r|ɾ]a na ɨ pupuŋa pania
S.TRANSL: 青蛙在竹製的瓶子裡面.
The frog was in the bamboo bottle.

FORM.notes: source note: acuu有表達行動過後的結果。 | source note: 孔老師不確定此字是否有詞根。 | source note: ’eseva是’esi-ava 音變而來，意思是「原來是」 | source note: ara-pa-pining指出去。

S.FORM: ʉ sh acuu si si'icʉpʉ 'aan tavarʉ'ʉ sua ʉncoo takarura ia 'eseva niarapapining tia manguru.
S.PHON: ɨ sh aʦuu si siʔiʦɨpɨ ʔaan tava[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨ sua ɨnʦoo taka[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ]a ia ʔeseva nia[r|ɾ]apapiniŋ tia maŋu[r|ɾ]u
S.FORM: ʉ sh acuu si si'icʉpʉ 'aan tavarʉ'ʉ sua ʉncoo takarura ia 'eseva niarapapining tia manguru.
S.PHON: ɨ sh aʦuu si siʔiʦɨpɨ ʔaan tava[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨ sua ɨnʦoo taka[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ]a ia ʔeseva nia[r|ɾ]apapiniŋ tia maŋu[r|ɾ]u
S.TRANSL: 嗯,在睡覺,不知道青蛙要逃到外面.
Well, (he) was sleeping, not knowing the frog was going to escape to outside.

FORM.notes: source note: mee為miaa音變而來。 | source note: takarʉ並沒有意思；maritakarʉ 抬起。 | source note: te=ku c<um>a-cʉ’ʉra pani 我要看Pani。 | source note: cʉmʉ’ʉra ‘ikua pori Pori看我。 | source note: te=ku c<um>a-cʉ’ʉra pani 我要看Pani。

S.FORM: ʉ mee aratakarʉ nguain cʉmʉ'ʉra sua ʉncoo takarura na 'esi ni na ʉncoo pania.
S.PHON: ɨ mee a[r|ɾ]ataka[r|ɾ]ɨ ŋuain ʦɨmɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]a sua ɨnʦoo taka[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ]a na ʔesi ni na ɨnʦoo pania
S.FORM: ʉ mee aratakarʉ nguain cʉmʉ'ʉra sua ʉncoo takarura na 'esi ni na ʉncoo pania.
S.PHON: ɨ mee a[r|ɾ]ataka[r|ɾ]ɨ ŋuain ʦɨmɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]a sua ɨnʦoo taka[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ]a na ʔesi ni na ɨnʦoo pania
S.TRANSL: 當他起來時,看到青蛙在瓶子裏面.
When he stood up, he saw the frog was in the bottle.

S.FORM: ʉ pupunga ia ʉ misen 'akiacu ʉ nimanguru.
S.PHON: ɨ pupuŋa ia ɨ misen ʔakiaʦu ɨ nimaŋu[r|ɾ]u
S.FORM: ʉ pupunga ia ʉ misen 'akiacu ʉ nimanguru.
S.PHON: ɨ pupuŋa ia ɨ misen ʔakiaʦu ɨ nimaŋu[r|ɾ]u
S.TRANSL: 為什麼(青蛙)不在瓶子裡?(青蛙)跑掉了.
Why wasn't it (frog) in the bottle? (It) escaped.

FORM.notes: source note: 孔老師猜測卡那卡那富語原本沒有i,o的音，此字應該會說成imuava。

S.FORM: imova sua nguain tamna tamtitu XXXX 'esi hm porun.
S.PHON: imova sua ŋuain tamna tamtitu **** ʔesi hm po[r|ɾ]un
S.FORM: imova sua nguain tamna tamtitu XXXX 'esi hm porun.
S.PHON: imova sua ŋuain tamna tamtitu **** ʔesi hm po[r|ɾ]un
S.TRANSL: 所以他的小狗吠叫.
Therefore, his puppy barked.

FORM.notes: source note: aratakarʉ 另有有動身(開始做)的意思。 | source note: maka-carapung為戴帽子之意。 | source note: numangʉ 刀; siki-numangʉ 佩刀。 | source note: cara’ʉ; musu-cara’ʉ 流血。

S.FORM: ʉ makasuacu ah aratakarʉ nguani ʉ nguain sua ʉncoo ma manu isi ma manu isi makacarapung.
S.PHON: ɨ makasuaʦu ah a[r|ɾ]ataka[r|ɾ]ɨ ŋuani ɨ ŋuain sua ɨnʦoo ma manu isi ma manu isi makaʦa[r|ɾ]apuŋ
S.FORM: ʉ makasuacu ah aratakarʉ nguani ʉ nguain sua ʉncoo ma manu isi ma manu isi makacarapung.
S.PHON: ɨ makasuaʦu ah a[r|ɾ]ataka[r|ɾ]ɨ ŋuani ɨ ŋuain sua ɨnʦoo ma manu isi ma manu isi makaʦa[r|ɾ]apuŋ
S.TRANSL: 之後,這小孩他起來帶戴帽子.
Afterwards, this kid, he stood up and put on the hat.

FORM.notes: source note: tikirim即是tikirimi變化而來；ti<ni>kirimi 找(過去)。 | source note: tikirima請找(主焦祈使); tikirimoo去找(受焦祈使)。 | source note: tikiriman 找找看。 | source note: ’apa-tikirimi 使…尋找; ’apa-tikirimi ’ikua cina tamtitu 媽媽讓我尋找小狗 | source note: tikirim即是tikirimi變化而來；ti<ni>kirimi 找(過去)。 | source note: sapuarʉ指網狀、可捕捉的工具。 | source note: mari-sapuarʉ 用撈的動作捕捉東西。

S.FORM: mataa tiki XXXX tikirimkee na ʉncoo sapuarʉ.
S.PHON: mataa tiki **** tiki[r|ɾ]imkee na ɨnʦoo sapua[r|ɾ]ɨ
S.FORM: mataa tiki XXXX tikirimkee na ʉncoo sapuarʉ.
S.PHON: mataa tiki **** tiki[r|ɾ]imkee na ɨnʦoo sapua[r|ɾ]ɨ
S.TRANSL: 然後,找網子.
Then, (he) looked for a net.

FORM.notes: source note: 詞根tʉvʉngʉ 沒有意義。 | source note: mitʉʉvʉng由mitʉvʉngʉ音變而來。

S.FORM: 'esikara nimitʉvʉng 'inia sua.
S.PHON: ʔesika[r|ɾ]a nimitɨvɨŋ ʔinia sua
S.FORM: 'esikara nimitʉvʉng 'inia sua.
S.PHON: ʔesika[r|ɾ]a nimitɨvɨŋ ʔinia sua
S.TRANSL: 他躲在那邊嗎?
Did it hide there?

FORM.notes: source note: 表達akia加了-ava暗示有恍然大悟的意思。

S.FORM: ʉ takaruru ʉ akiava.
S.PHON: ɨ taka[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ]u ɨ akiava
S.FORM: ʉ takaruru ʉ akiava.
S.PHON: ɨ taka[r|ɾ]u[r|ɾ]u ɨ akiava
S.TRANSL: 青蛙竟然不見了!
The frog should be gone!

FORM.notes: source note: sovu 味道 | source note: mari-sovu 聞; mari-sovu pani vungavung Pani聞花。

S.FORM: ʉ makasua sua ʉncoo nguain tamna tamtitu ia ʉ 'esi arisovuunkee sua pania ʉ pupunga.
S.PHON: ɨ makasua sua ɨnʦoo ŋuain tamna tamtitu ia ɨ ʔesi a[r|ɾ]isovuunkee sua pania ɨ pupuŋa
S.FORM: ʉ makasua sua ʉncoo nguain tamna tamtitu ia ʉ 'esi arisovuunkee sua pania ʉ pupunga.
S.PHON: ɨ makasua sua ɨnʦoo ŋuain tamna tamtitu ia ɨ ʔesi a[r|ɾ]isovuunkee sua pania ɨ pupuŋa
S.TRANSL: 之後,他的小狗聞竹製的瓶子.
Afterwards, his dog smelt the bamboo bottle.

S.FORM: 'esikara tisikara 'inia?
S.PHON: ʔesika[r|ɾ]a tisika[r|ɾ]a ʔinia
S.FORM: 'esikara tisikara 'inia?
S.PHON: ʔesika[r|ɾ]a tisika[r|ɾ]a ʔinia
S.TRANSL: 有在裡面嗎?
Was it inside there?

FORM.notes: source note: 孔老師不確定’ukunai的意思，但范秀月老師認為是「哪裡」。 | source note: 此字音發為tapucara，若p後面接有母音可能會不發音。 | source note: amacara 上面; amurocu 下面。 | source note: sinʉva應為si’inʉva的簡化。

S.FORM: ʉ 'ukunai na ʉncoo ʉ tapcara sinʉva.
S.PHON: ɨ ʔukunai na ɨnʦoo ɨ tapʦa[r|ɾ]a sinɨva
S.FORM: ʉ 'ukunai na ʉncoo ʉ tapcara sinʉva.
S.PHON: ɨ ʔukunai na ɨnʦoo ɨ tapʦa[r|ɾ]a sinɨva
S.TRANSL: 在門的上面.
(It's) above the door.

FORM.notes: source note: tarakusa指往某個方向看。

S.FORM: ʉ tarakusa pipining ʉ cumacʉ'ʉra tikirim.
S.PHON: ɨ ta[r|ɾ]akusa pipiniŋ ɨ ʦumaʦɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]a tiki[r|ɾ]im
S.FORM: ʉ tarakusa pipining ʉ cumacʉ'ʉra tikirim.
S.PHON: ɨ ta[r|ɾ]akusa pipiniŋ ɨ ʦumaʦɨʔɨ[r|ɾ]a tiki[r|ɾ]im
S.TRANSL: (狗)向外面看,尋找(青蛙).
(The dog) looked toward outside, looking for (the frog).

FORM.notes: source note: pupunga後面接了pania形容像瓶子的容器。

S.FORM: sua ʉncoo nguain tamna tamtitu ia ha'au koo 'aan tavarʉ'ʉ 'esi na navungin sua ʉncoo ʉ pupunga ah pania.
S.PHON: sua ɨnʦoo ŋuain tamna tamtitu ia haʔau koo ʔaan tava[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨ ʔesi na navuŋin sua ɨnʦoo ɨ pupuŋa ah pania
S.FORM: sua ʉncoo nguain tamna tamtitu ia ha'au koo 'aan tavarʉ'ʉ 'esi na navungin sua ʉncoo ʉ pupunga ah pania.
S.PHON: sua ɨnʦoo ŋuain tamna tamtitu ia haʔau koo ʔaan tava[r|ɾ]ɨʔɨ ʔesi na navuŋin sua ɨnʦoo ɨ pupuŋa ah pania
S.TRANSL: 他的狗不知道他的頭在竹製的瓶子裡.
His dog didn't know his head was in the bamboo bottle.

FORM.notes: source note: 表示位置時常會用 ta或ra或tara，孔老師猜測這句話可能是表達門的方向或者指窗戶所在的位置 (tara-sinʉva)。 | source note: ’ʉnai指土地、土壤，這裡重疊音節特指地面。 | source note: 以mata-為詞首的尚有mata-cuvucuvungu 集合、相聚。 | source note: 詞根為mususkʉmʉ，後音變成musukom。

S.PHON: makasuaʦu nimatapa[r|ɾ]iʔi na a[r|ɾ]anai na tapʦa[r|ɾ]aa sinɨva makasi na ʔɨnɨʔɨnai matapa[r|ɾ]iʔi ɨ manasɨ musukom
S.FORM: makasuacu nimatapari'i na aranai na tapcaraa sinʉva makasi na 'ʉnʉ'ʉnai matapari'i ʉ manasʉ musukom.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu nimatapa[r|ɾ]iʔi na a[r|ɾ]anai na tapʦa[r|ɾ]aa sinɨva makasi na ʔɨnɨʔɨnai matapa[r|ɾ]iʔi ɨ manasɨ musukom
S.TRANSL: (狗)從門的上面掉到地上,可能很痛.
(The dog) fell from the door to the ground. It perhaps got hurt.

S.FORM: sua ʉncoo ʉ manu Pori kisʉʉn nia ʉ nerikee sua nguain tamna tacau.
S.PHON: sua ɨnʦoo ɨ manu po[r|ɾ]i kisɨɨn nia ɨ ne[r|ɾ]ikee sua ŋuain tamna taʦau
S.FORM: sua ʉncoo ʉ manu Pori kisʉʉn nia ʉ nerikee sua nguain tamna tacau.
S.PHON: sua ɨnʦoo ɨ manu po[r|ɾ]i kisɨɨn nia ɨ ne[r|ɾ]ikee sua ŋuain tamna taʦau
S.TRANSL: 然後,那個叫Pori的小孩把他的狗拴住.
Then, the kid called Pori fastened his dog.

S.FORM: ʉ maris marisari eh sii manasʉ musukom.

S.FORM: ʉ maris marisari eh sii manasʉ musukom.
S.PHON: ɨ ma[r|ɾ]is ma[r|ɾ]isa[r|ɾ]i eh sii manasɨ musukom
S.TRANSL: (狗)可能因為痛而叫.
(The dog) barked perhaps because it hurt.

FORM.notes: source note: mari-purupu 打破，詞根為purupu。 | source note: ni-ara-purupuru=maku takupin 我打破碗了。 | source note: ravi’a 裂開。 | source note: 根據孔老師，pania通常為玻璃製成的瓶子。 | source note: pania pupunga 表形狀像瓶子的容器。

S.FORM: acuu nim uh niarapurupuru sua ʉncoo ʉ pania ʉ pupunga.
S.PHON: aʦuu nim uh nia[r|ɾ]apu[r|ɾ]upu[r|ɾ]u sua ɨnʦoo ɨ pania ɨ pupuŋa
S.TRANSL: (狗)打破了竹製的瓶子.
(The dog) broke the bamboo bottle.

FORM.notes: source note: 原意是「去了」，後虛化成一種discourse marker，表示連續動作的進行(接續)。 | source note: pipining由pipiningi音變而來。 | source note: 根據孔老師:最早的發音為aracaini，後音變為araceni，再音變為aracen。

S.PHON: eh makasuaʦu aʦuu pipiniŋ ta[r|ɾ]akusa ɨnʦoo na a[r|ɾ]aʦen
S.FORM: eh makasuacu acuu pipining tarakusa ʉncoo na aracen.
S.PHON: eh makasuaʦu aʦuu pipiniŋ ta[r|ɾ]akusa ɨnʦoo na a[r|ɾ]aʦen
S.TRANSL: 之後,(狗)到外面望向遠方.
Afterwards, (the dog) went outside, looking far away.

FORM.notes: source note: 此處重複指「一直尋找」。 | source note: cʉvʉrʉ 指動物或人類的生長; apa-cʉvʉrʉ 飼養。 | source note: ara-tatia 指植物的生長。
